actor_execution: stochastic tanh Gaussian, unchanged historical frozen_actor helper
actor_reason: historical default actor in run_distribution_matching and run_rollout_return; chosen before new outcomes
first_action: one draw per context held fixed across all repeats; every scorer receives that exact action
coverage: visible waypoint shortcut/detour or uniform; speed .55/.9 by (parent//4)%2, Gaussian .12, pauses t=5,6,13; fixed actor source stochastic
selection: 2 candidates per parent without replacement, inverse global (region,progress,motion) count, 4x weight outside strict radius-2 goal
restoration: deep copy full native environment plus external elapsed counter; fresh future RNG retains initial bits/absorption/history/time
repeats_interpretation: future randomness conditional on one full simulator snapshot, not hidden posterior draws

pairing.algorithm: existing make_pairs, one random anchor per parent; greedily match unused distinct parent; each parent at most once
pairing.reliable_order: abs(mean difference) > max(0.5, t_0.975_Welch * independent-repeat SE); diagnostic, not simultaneous testing

statistics.aggregate: parent-cluster bootstrap, both contexts together; within each context resample its 24 repeats
statistics.pairs: resample disjoint parent-pair blocks; independently resample repeats, report fixed reliable subset and order-flip sensitivity
statistics.comparisons: paired same resamples for alpha .3 minus 0, phi versus own scalar, phi versus raw baselines

support.inputs: 8 observed F4 + recorded first action 2 + constant goal 8
support.scaling: saved raw ridge training mean/std; never refit on new contexts

stopping: one collection, one evaluation; no outcome-dependent budget changes, no fitting or ETT
